meta.title: Yell County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Yell County's 2026 budget, adopted by Appropriation Ordinance 2025-20 on Dec. 8, 2025 and filed with the state. Amounts come from the '2026 Budget' column of each office's budget page, and they match the ordinance. The 0.87% sales tax fund ($850,000) mostly moves money into the General Fund, so those dollars are counted in both funds.

nodes.name: Other services and charges
nodes.note: The page prints a dash for this group total; its two lines (Fire & Extended Coverage $3,950.00 and Waste Disposal $25,000.00) add to the office total.

nodes.name: Transfers
nodes.note: The page says the county treasurer will transfer this $25,000.00 to the County Emergency Fund.

nodes.name: Local Assistance and Tribal Consistency Fund (LATCF)
County 0.87% Sales Tax
nodes.note: Its two lines are '9996 County General' $830,000.00 and '9998 Fire Control' $20,000.00. The page says the treasurer will transfer $680,000.00 to the County General Fund during the year and $20,000.00 to County Grants-in-Aid for fire control, so this money is counted again where it is spent.

nodes.name: County Road Motor Fuel Tax Act
nodes.note: The page lists its only amount, '1004 Contract Labor' $100,000.00, under Supplies (whose group total is a dash) but prints the $100,000.00 group total under Capital Outlay, so we stop at the fund total.
